title: Slots Time
description: This is a simple mod that adds a slot machine
body:
A simple mod that adds in a slot machine and some coins.
I made this mod for me and my friends so dont expect any updates.
(I'm not very good at making mods so expect a not very well made mod)


You can change luck values of each coin in the configs.
Here is a google sheets of the win calculation. To edit just switch the values in the "Luck Value" column. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XqX6cHQXvR7jgnKiou7IOs6Uuc5GMQirivxLT0biDOY/template/preview
